summary: Round 2: all eight round-1 issues are fixed. The two placeholders are now distinct quiet scenes (the night porter's moorings, the chandler's downstairs), the loft cards use real checks, the end desk cycles without a payoff, the firm is the mother's, and Nan Merrow is renamed everywhere (lore, cards, zh 南·梅罗, glossary) and introduced at first mention. Only two small polish points remain on the rewritten placeholders.

issues.problem: Continuity (small): the rewritten text is 'After hours ... the night porter is lighting his lantern for his round', but the card has no time, so it can come up on a morning visit. counting_house_end_desk now keeps to the daytime, so this card is the natural evening fallback.
Length (small): the label 'Climb up and sleep in your old hammock' is 38 characters, over the 36-character guide.
issues.fix: Shorten it to 'Sleep in your old hammock' (zh can stay as it is).
